# GD Pro Web Designs

> Freelance web design, WordPress development, and SEO consultancy run by JA Armira,
> based in Everett, Massachusetts (3 miles from downtown Boston) and operating since
> 2005. Serves small businesses across Greater Boston, the North Shore, and the whole
> state of Massachusetts, plus remote clients nationwide. Work is done directly by one
> Google-certified consultant — no agency layers — at flat-rate pricing with no
> long-term contracts. English and Spanish.

## Business facts

- Legal/brand name: GD Pro Web Designs (also written GDWebPros)
- Owner / lead consultant: JA Armira
- Founded: 2005
- Location: Lawrence St., Everett, MA 02149, United States
- Phone: (617) 771-0645
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00–18:00 ET
- Website: https://gdprowebdesigns.com
- Contact / quote request: https://gdprowebdesigns.com/gd-blog/contact-us
- Credentials: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Certificate; Google SEO Certificate
- Languages: English, Spanish
- Service model: freelance / one consultant, flat-rate pricing, no long-term contract
- Service area: Everett, Boston, Chelsea, Malden, Medford, Somerville, Cambridge,
  Revere, Saugus, Lynn, Salem, Peabody, Beverly, Waltham, Newton, Quincy, Dedham,
  Winchester, Lawrence, and all of Massachusetts; remote clients nationwide

## Services and starting prices

- Custom web design (mobile-first, responsive): from about $1,800
- WordPress development / WooCommerce / custom themes & plugins: from about $2,500
- WordPress maintenance & support plans: from $450/month
- Search engine optimization (local & national): from $450/month
- Google Ads (PPC) management: flat monthly management fee, separate from ad budget
- Digital / local internet marketing
- Graphic design & branding (logos, print, menus)
- SEO-safe WordPress migrations
- AI search visibility audits & optimization (GEO / generative engine optimization)
